facts.fact: The Digital Convergence Initiative says Cameroon is assessing its Common ID System, Civil Registration System and Disability Registry to explore their integration with the Unified Social Registry (RESUC) MIS.
facts.system: Unified Social Registry (RESUC) Management Information System

facts.fact: The same source says a feasibility study is under way to design an integrated digital payment platform connecting the RESUC MIS with payment service providers.
